in_hebrew.name: Piotr
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Rock or foundation
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Piotr הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old Slavic word pětrъ, which means 'rock' or 'foundation'. In Christian tradition, Piotr is associated with Saint Peter, the apostle who is said to have been the first pope and the leader of the early Christian church.
